title: Computer Literacy Basics
description: Learn the fundamentals of using a computer: files, folders, emails, and keyboard shortcuts.

competencies.name: Navigate File Explorer
competencies.description: Open folders, understand paths, and use breadcrumbs.

competencies.name: Create and Name Folders
competencies.description: Create new folders and rename them appropriately.

competencies.name: Compose an Email
competencies.description: Write an email with a subject, recipient, and body.

competencies.name: Attach a File to an Email
competencies.description: Browse for and attach a file to an outgoing email.

lessons.title: Files & Folders
lessons.description: Learn how files are organised and how to create folders.

blocks.content:
A **file** is a digital document. It could be a photo, a video, a letter, or a spreadsheet.

Files live inside **folders** (also called directories). Think of a folder like a drawer in a filing cabinet.

Every file has a **name** and a **type** (shown by the extension, like `.docx` or `.jpg`).

blocks.caption: Watch how files and folders work on a computer.

blocks.content: If you can't find your files, you can't finish your homework. Organisation is a superpower.

config.instruction: Open the Maths folder inside School.

hints: Look for the Documents folder first.
scoring.successMessage: Great! You found the Maths folder.
scoring.incorrectMessage: You need to open Documents → School → Maths.

blocks.content:
Your teacher asked you to save all your English work in one place.

1. Right-click in empty space.
2. Choose **New Folder**.
3. Name it **English**.

hints: Right-click on empty space in the folder view.
scoring.successMessage: Perfect! Your English folder is ready for homework.
scoring.incorrectMessage: Make sure you created a folder named 'English' inside Documents.

lessons.title: Sending Emails
lessons.description: Learn how to write a clear email and attach a file.

blocks.content:
Every email has four key parts:

- **To:** The person you are writing to.
- **Subject:** A short summary of what the email is about.
- **Body:** The main message.
- **Attachments:** Files you include with the email.
Always use a clear subject line. Teachers get lots of emails: make yours easy to find.

hints: Include the word 'homework' in the subject.
Write at least one sentence in the body.
scoring.successMessage: Email sent! Clear subject, proper recipient, and a polite body.
scoring.incorrectMessage: Check the recipient, subject, and that you wrote something in the body.
